anyRunning reports active backups on the selected account. sites is populated only while processing a backup. The source describes site id as unimplemented and null-only, but its formal schema is nullable string; retain that schema without inventing a concrete ID contract. sse_url is returned data and is not followed.

Cancels an active site backup. Payload ok=0 means cancellation was not possible or no backup was active; ok=1 means it was cancelled. Inspect this flag separately from API status. The source promises no rollback of the backup work already performed.

The pinned site input is a string URL without a protocol prefix. Supply a string. The current generator loses the outer type across format-only anyOf alternatives, so the generated native input boundary remains string|int; this does not establish integer site semantics or validate domain/path formats. The input-narrowing limitation is tracked under whm-api-client-8x0.1.23. The optional response site field retains the known source string type and rejects null or non-string values.

Releases system resources from a previous site backup. ok=0 reports a backup still in progress and ok=1 reports resources released. The entire data value is nullable; explicit null is valid, while an absent data member is a mismatch. Do not interpret resource cleanup as deleting the backup archive.
